3401 Alexander Pope 1688-1744 John Bartlett

 
 
 
NUMBER:
3401
 
AUTHOR:
Alexander Pope
 (1688–1744)
 
QUOTATION:
The spider’s touch, how exquisitely fine!
Feels at each thread, and lives along the line.
 
1
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Essay on Man. Epistle i. Line 217.
